title: Lifting Pentagon-Arrangement Symmetries to Homotopy Invariants
statement: For the pentagon hyperplane arrangement whose combinatorial symmetry induces an automorphism of the complement homology, can this automorphism extend to an automorphism of the $E^\infty$-coalgebra, and can it extend to an automorphism of the fundamental group?
